name: Fire Elemental

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: At the end of each of its turns, the elemental deals 5 (1d10) Fire damage to every creature in a 10-foot Emanation and sets flammable objects alight.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: Takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

actions.name: Burn
actions.desc: If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

desc: A living bonfire that wants only to spread. It leaves ash where it walks.
